limits: Ogg Opus v1 mono/stereo mapping 0, 48kHz clock, pre-skip <=3840 and multiple of 3, granule origin 0 only
Single logical stream; no Ogg Vorbis, chaining/multiplexing, live, sparse ranges, configuration changes or missing pages
EOS end trim within final packet; headers finish on pages before audio; empty pages excluded
Native packet/PCM cases include 2.5/5/10/20/40/60ms, continuation, gain and single-sample end trim; UI scenarios use 10/20ms mono/stereo
Digital PCM/software audio only; physical A/V delay and drift not claimed; UI seek is not promised sample-exact
Installed Windows applications unchanged; SDK ZIP contains no updated EXE/MSI installers
Full audio matrix, long-run stress and real Harvester integration remain open
